description: This file contains unit tests for the ImageHandler class within the OpenMRS medical record system. It employs JUnit 5 to verify support for specific image views, correct handling of MIME types, and saving complex image data associated with Obs objects.

classes.name: ImageHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying ImageHandler functionalities related to image support, MIME types, and data saving within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Verifies that the handler supports the 'RAW_VIEW' format.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Checks that the handler correctly indicates support for the 'RAW_VIEW'.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Confirms that the handler does not support non-RAW views such as HTML, preview, text, title, and URI views, or null/empty inputs.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests that saving an image as ComplexData in an Obs assigns the correct MIME type.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldHandleByteArrays
methods.description: Verifies that the handler can save image data provided as byte arrays.
